body.statement: Does \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{coll}}(P)\) determine \(\kappa_\alpha\) such that \(R_{N,\alpha}(u)/\min\{1,u^{-1/2}\}\to\kappa_\alpha\) uniformly on compact nondegenerate faces of \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{coll}}(p_T,\mathcal H)\), and can an inversion derived through \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{sharp}}\) attain it while retaining honesty at face transitions?
body.justification: The rate theorem does not determine the exact confidence-length constant or optimal test shape.
body.gap: Mikusheva studies invariant weak-IV geometry and Cai and Low sharp Gaussian moduli, but neither covers causal allocation-face transitions.
body.consumer: An exact constant would compare collections with similar rate indices but different finite-strength geometry.
